name: trama
description: See your System as a layered Model of state machines, review Proposals and Drifts, and steer your coding agent from one editor tab.

commands.title: Send to agent (closing the tab sends it too)

enumDescriptions: The editor's chat: Copilot in VS Code, Cursor in Cursor.
omp in the editor's integrated terminal.
Claude Code in the editor's integrated terminal.
trama.agent.markdownDescription: Agent used for every project and instruction: `chat` (the editor's chat: Copilot in VS Code, Cursor in Cursor; the default), `omp` (omp in the editor's integrated terminal) or `claude` (Claude Code in the editor's integrated terminal). It applies only in your user settings.

trama.ompPath.markdownDescription: Path of the `omp` program the Settings tab runs (`omp models --json`) to suggest model names. Empty uses `omp` from the editor's PATH. It applies only in your user settings.

enumDescriptions: A terminal tab in the active editor group.
trama.terminalLocation.markdownDescription: Where `omp` and Claude Code terminals open: `panel` (the terminal area; the default) or `editor` (a terminal tab in the active editor group). It applies only in your user settings.

enumDescriptions: Manual: you decide on every Drift (the default).
The agent recommends, approves and fixes non-critical Drifts on its own.
Like enabled, critical Drifts included: the ones where your decision is urgently needed.
trama.driftAutoPilot.markdownDescription: How much the agent does with Drifts on its own: `disabled` (the default; you decide on every Drift), `enabled` (the agent recommends, approves and fixes non-critical Drifts on its own) or `yolo` (like `enabled`, critical Drifts included, the ones where your decision is urgently needed). It applies only in your user settings. After opening the editor, a finished scan or an explicit Resolve Drifts request is required before automatic collection resumes. A Task whose origin Drift is being fixed runs only after its fix Tasks are Done. A scan that failed or was interrupted counts as finished and does not suspend the delegation. Repeated automatic cycles have no additional limit. Lowering it stops new automatic steps but does not interrupt a Task already started.

trama.submitWhileRunning.markdownDescription: Let a run start while another run started by Trama is in progress. Off (the default): Run and Run all are unavailable while a run started by Trama is in progress. On: a run can start while another one is in progress.

trama.analysis.markdownDescription: Model for design work: written design requests, Resolve Drifts, the preparation of automatic Drift resolution and import. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.scan.markdownDescription: Model for scans: of the System, of Features, and for the sub-agents that compare Machines, including those of the pre-flight check at the start of each Run. With the Advisor Scanner on, the omp advisors that watch Runs use it too. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. The chats' sub-agents get it with Update skills. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.execution.markdownDescription: Model for implementing Tasks: implement, implement all and the automatic Run, including the pre-flight of each Run and the selective final scan of the run. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.autoExit.markdownDescription: Close the agent's terminal as soon as the agent is idle or its command ends (default on). With it off, idle terminals stay open and every instruction still opens a new one. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.maxParallelAgents.markdownDescription: How many sub-agents the agent may run at once, in a scan, in the exploration of a design and in a run of Tasks (default 20; agents without sub-agents ignore it).

trama.skillsDir.markdownDescription: Folder, relative to the project root, where Get Started and **Trama: Update Agent Skills** install the agent skills. Use `.claude/skills` for Claude Code.

trama.language.markdownDescription: Language the agent writes in, for example `Italian` or `Deutsch`. Empty by default: Trama never fills it in. When set, every instruction Trama sends to the agent asks it to write everything it generates in that language, except code, which always stays in English. Empty asks nothing about language. It only reaches agents that Trama starts, changes nothing already written, and the Trama interface stays in English.

trama.experimentalDriftBlocker.markdownDescription: Experimental. On: the agent that files a Drift checks which of the Tasks it would block are really affected, blocks only those and says why it leaves each other one free; a Drift that blocks no Task is filed inside a resolution Proposal for you to approve. Off (the default): a Drift blocks every Task that concerns the same thing. Only agents started by Trama follow it.

trama.experimentalAdvisorScanner.markdownDescription: Experimental. Only with omp as the agent. On: during every Run, omp's advisor checks the code the agent reads and writes against the Model and the Requirements, tells the agent when its work drifts and files a Drift for a difference in existing code; every scan is off (Scan buttons, the pre-flight and the end-of-run scan). The advisor uses the Scan model. Off (the default), or with another agent: scans work as usual. Trama's advisors live in `.omp/WATCHDOG.yml`, installed in every project: in an omp session you start yourself with the advisor on, they replace omp's default advisor and stay silent.
